sources.finding: Version 0.6.4, MIT, bin `looptroop`, Node >=24.19.0, homepage https://www.looptroop.ovh/.

sources.title: CLI definition
sources.locator: usage text: open, start, stop, restart, status, logs, doctor, setup, clean
sources.finding: Nine product-owned commands that run, inspect and diagnose the local daemon; none create or steer tickets.

sources.title: CLI Reference
sources.locator: Commands and options; open; start/stop/restart
sources.finding: Daemon binds 127.0.0.1:3000, keeps running after the shell closes, `open` signs the browser in with a single-use code; 12-hour sessions; bearer token for automation.

sources.title: Getting Started
sources.locator: Prerequisites; Setting Up Your AI Council; Free Model Options; Attaching Your First Project
sources.finding: Needs OpenCode with a configured provider and a local git repo with a GitHub origin; models and subscriptions come from OpenCode; free OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM and OpenCode Go options.

sources.title: Installation
sources.locator: Channels table; Platforms with no executable; Running in a container
sources.finding: curl/PowerShell, npm, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, WinGet, bun, pnpm, Yarn, Docker and standalone executables for macOS arm64, Linux x64/arm64 and Windows x64.

sources.title: Configuration Reference
sources.locator: AI Models; Council Members; Manual QA; Max Bead Retries; Remote access and credentials; Git Hook Policy
sources.finding: Profile settings with defaults: council 2-10 models, retry limits, timeouts, Manual QA, Git-hook policy, remote access opt-in with HTTPS public origin.

sources.title: API Reference
sources.locator: Reaching An Installed Daemon; Ticket Routes; Prompt Customization Routes; SSE Events
sources.finding: Local REST API under /api with cookie or bearer authentication, ticket lifecycle actions, artifacts, logs export, prompt editing and SSE streams; same API as the UI.

sources.title: Ticket Flow
sources.locator: At A Glance; Execution Band; Kanban Board Locations; User Actions; Safe Resume
sources.finding: Ticket state machine from DRAFT to COMPLETED with approval gates, a Kanban board, one ticket per project in the execution band, BLOCKED_ERROR recovery and restart rehydration.

sources.title: Beads & Execution
sources.locator: Current Bead Shape; Scheduler Rules; Single-Bead Execution Cycle; Retry, Reset, Context-Wipe Notes
sources.finding: Beads carry dependencies.blocked_by, priority, target files and tests; scheduler runs only pending beads whose blockers are done; retries use fresh sessions with a context-wipe note.

sources.title: LLM Council
sources.locator: Draft, vote, refine, verify; stopping or retrying one model
sources.finding: Council of 2-10 distinct models drafts, scores, votes and refines interview, PRD and bead plans; individual models can be stopped or retried.

sources.title: OpenCode Integration
sources.locator: Core Modules; Session Ownership; Tool Policy Layer; Reconnect Behavior; Questions And Human Input
sources.finding: LoopTroop supervises or adopts an OpenCode server, uses its providers, MCP servers and skills, owns sessions, guards direct GitHub and destructive git writes and reconnects after restarts.

sources.title: Post-Implementation
sources.locator: RUNNING_FINAL_TEST; INTEGRATING_CHANGES; CREATING_PULL_REQUEST; WAITING_PR_REVIEW; CLEANING_ENV
sources.finding: Final test gate, optional Manual QA, squash into one candidate commit, draft PR via GitHub, human Merge or Finish Without Merge, cleanup that preserves evidence.

sources.title: Operations Guide
sources.locator: State files; Child-process credentials; Runtime storage; Worktree Disk Cleanup
sources.finding: State in a 0700 configuration directory plus <project>/.looptroop (db.sqlite, worktrees, logs); credentials filtering; worktrees are not a sandbox.

sources.title: Frontend
sources.locator: Dashboard; Kanban filters; narrow screens; Manual QA workspace
sources.finding: React browser UI with a Kanban dashboard, ticket workspace, search and triage filters, council/bead/diff views and narrow-screen handling.

sources.title: Database Schema
sources.locator: ticket_ai_turn_metrics; tables overview
sources.finding: SQLite tables for tickets, artifacts, attempts, status history, errors, bead metrics and per-turn AI cost and token usage.

sources.title: Runtime Diagnostics
sources.locator: looptroop doctor; Blocked-Error Diagnostics; Sensitive Data Redaction
sources.finding: Fifteen doctor checks, blocked-error diagnostics with redaction, structured retry diagnostics.

sources.title: Roadmap
sources.locator: status note; High Priority
sources.finding: Undated planning notes (context slimming, critique pre-pass, knowledge harvest, living project specs, comments, WYSIWYG editor); the page says entries are not delivery commitments.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.finding: v0.6.4 released 2026-11-06 is a breaking release that refuses older databases; Unreleased section is empty.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.locator: Supported Versions; Reporting a Vulnerability
sources.finding: Only the latest release gets fixes; private GitHub advisories; best-effort timelines, no contractual response.

sources.title: Execution allow-all permissions
sources.locator: OPENCODE_EXECUTION_ALLOW_ALL_PERMISSIONS
sources.finding: Execution sessions get allow-all rules for every permission and path, matching the documented YOLO mode.

sources.title: Bead scheduler
sources.locator: getRunnable, getNextBead, isAllComplete
sources.finding: Runnable beads are pending beads whose blocked_by are done; next bead is the lowest priority number.

sources.title: AI turn metrics
sources.locator: AiTurnMetricInput; AiDetailsSummary
sources.finding: Records cost_usd, input/output/reasoning/cache tokens and duration per completed assistant message and summarises them per ticket with coverage counts.

sources.title: Update check
sources.locator: LATEST_RELEASE_URL, CHECK_INTERVAL_MS
sources.finding: Only outbound product call found: GET to api.github.com releases/latest every 15 minutes at most to show update steps; nothing is installed or sent about the user.

sources.title: Bounded search: MCP server or client
sources.locator: rg -i "\bmcp\b|model context protocol" over server/, shared/, src/, package.json
sources.finding: No MCP server or client implementation in LoopTroop; MCP tools are inherited from the user OpenCode configuration.

sources.title: Bounded search: schedules, webhooks and notifications
sources.locator: rg -i "webhook|crontab|\bcron\b|new Notification|web push|serviceWorker|slack|discord|telegram" over server/, shared/, src/
sources.finding: No webhook, cron, browser notification or chat-integration code; tickets start only by a user Start action.

sources.title: Bounded search: users, roles, SSO
sources.locator: rg -i "sso|saml|oidc|rbac|organization|membership|userId" over server/, shared/, src/ (non-test)
sources.finding: No user accounts, roles, membership or SSO; one session cookie or bearer token per daemon.

sources.title: Bounded search: native clients
sources.locator: rg -i "ios|android|electron|tauri" over server/, shared/, src/; package.json bin and scripts
sources.finding: No iOS, Android, Electron or Tauri client; the UI is a React app served by the daemon to a browser.

sources.title: Bounded search: external tracker import
sources.locator: rg -i "gh issue|issues\.list|listIssues|linear|jira" over server/, shared/, src/
sources.finding: No GitHub, Linear or Jira issue import; tickets are created in the LoopTroop UI (the GitHub origin is used for PRs).

sources.title: Bounded search: coding harness adapters
sources.locator: ls server/opencode/; rg -i "claude-code|codex cli|gemini-cli|cursor-agent|aider" over server/
sources.finding: Only an OpenCode adapter (v1/v2 transports) exists; no other harness adapter.

sources.title: Bounded search: hosted service or per-task container/VM
sources.locator: rg -i "docker|container|firecracker|vm\b|saas|managed cloud" over server/, shared/; docs installation.md
sources.finding: No hosted service and no per-task container or VM isolation; Docker is an image for the daemon itself and OpenCode runs on the same host as worktrees.

sources.title: Bounded search: spend, token and budget limits
sources.locator: rg -i "budget|spend limit|maxCost|token limit|maxTokens|cost cap" over server/, shared/, src/
sources.finding: No spend, token or budget limit; limits are time, retry and step caps. Cost columns are recorded for display only.

sources.title: Bounded search: revert and deploy
sources.locator: rg -i "revert|rollback|deploy|release" over server/phases, server/git, server/workflow
sources.finding: Only safe worktree reset between retries and PR creation/merge; no deployment, release or post-merge revert feature.
